title: The four tiers
desc: Each change gets a tier from the files it touches. Tier 1, a small fix, needs locked tests. Tier 2, a normal change, adds a plan and a review. Tier 3, login, payments, or user data, adds a review on GitHub. Tier 4, data, production, or the locks themselves, adds a person's approval.

nodes.text:
A normal change
+ a plan and a review

Login, payments, data
+ a review on GitHub

Production, the locks
+ a person approves
